idea: 042 Dear dollars on Bitfinex: the margin funding rate as a crowding gauge (scout idea 28)
hypothesis: When borrowing dollars on Bitfinex for 2 days costs 0.05 % a day or more (about 18 % a year), margin longs in bitcoin are crowded and bitcoin falls (or rises less than usual) over the next day: sell BTC at 00:00 UTC on weekdays, hold one day.
mechanism: Margin buyers on Bitfinex borrow USD from lenders; the 2-day USD funding rate is the price of that leverage. A high rate means demand for leveraged long exposure exceeds lenders' supply: the long side is crowded, carry is expensive, and forced or voluntary deleveraging should follow. A fade of leverage, the opposite of the breakout rules; not a closed family (no funding/positioning gauge of crypto was tested by the lab; Binance perp funding starts 2019-09 only).

data.signal: Bitfinex public API, https://api-pub.bitfinex.com/v2/candles/trade:1D:fUSD:p2/hist (daily candles of the USD margin-funding rate, 2-day period, rate per day; first candle 2016-07-31). Field: close of the daily candle that starts at D 00:00 UTC = the last funding trade before D+1 00:00 UTC. KNOWN AT: D+1 00:00 UTC (the candle's end; real time, not revised, sources.md section 13). Fetched once 2026-11-19, cached in ~/explore_data/idea_042/funding/fusd_p2_1d.json, request bounded at 2021-12-31 23:59 UTC.
data.publication_lag: data.external(obs = candle start date D, known = D + 1 day 00:00 UTC, min_lag = 1 day). Not revised.
data.prices: kit.data.load_bars('btcusd', 2016, venue='bitstamp') = Bitstamp BTC/USD hourly candles (trade prices treated as mid), FP crypto weekend closure removed. Information only (not judged, not a trial): the same main signals priced on Bitfinex BTC/USD hourly and on Binance BTCUSDT from 2017-08.

rule_main.signal: r(D) = close of the Bitfinex trade:1D:fUSD:p2 candle starting D 00:00 UTC, known at D+1 00:00 UTC. Signal at known_at = D+1 00:00 UTC if r(D) >= 0.0005 and D+1 is Monday to Friday (UTC weekday of known_at), known_at >= 2016-11-01.
rule_main.entry: open of the first H1 bar opening at or after known_at (the 00:00 UTC bar), max_wait_h = 2
rule_main.overlap: one position per market (kit.sim mode 'one'); every-signal variant for the every-signal bar

what_changed_vs_brief: The brief exits after 24 hours. With the kit's one-position filter a 24 h exit happens at the open of the next 00:00 bar and the next day's signal enters that same bar, which the kit skips (the next entry must open after the exit bar): consecutive dear-dollar days would be taken one in two (about 227 trades instead of 351, under the 250 bar). The main exit is therefore 23 hours (the open of the 23:00 UTC bar), so every weekday signal can be taken; the 47 h neighbour keeps the brief's longer hold. A Friday trade's exit falls in FP's weekend closure and is done at the close of the last bar before it (kit convention). Prices: Bitstamp (the brief allows Bitfinex or Bitstamp) because Bitfinex's own BTC price carried a premium in 2017 tied to its dollar troubles, the same episode that lifts the funding rate.
